sentences.text: 2. Ms.Prasanna Lakshmi, learned Assistant Public Prosecutor would submit that the matter is settled between the parties before Lok Adalat.
3. Sri P.S.P.Suresh Kumar, learned counsel for the Petitioners is in attendance.
4. In that view of the matter, the criminal petition is dismissed as the relief has become infructuous.
Pending applications, if any, shall stand closed.
